newsitem.title: USA: CFTC sues AVCO for technical analysis software.
newsitem.headline: CFTC sues AVCO for technical analysis software.

text.p: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission on Wednesday filed a civil lawsuit against AVCO Financial Corp for alleged fraud in selling a technical analysis software program.
The lawsuit, filed in federal court in New York City, also named Anthony Vartuli and J.Michael Gent. Both men and AVCO are based in Connecticut.

Court papers alleged that AVCO, Vartuli and Gent fraudulently solicited customers to buy the software program, known as Recurrence, which provides advice about transactions in exchange-traded foreign currency futures.
The lawsuit also accused AVCO of acting as an unregistered commodity trading advisor and misrepresneting the ability of Recurrence to pick profitable trades.
The CFTC asked the court to issue a permanent injunction against AVCO and the two men, and assess financial penalties.
